author: 0Ysk
content: Plan: Implement M10 in 5 commits: 1) cultures.ts — per-region cultural traits, 2) religions.ts — pantheons/deities/rituals/holy sites, 3) polities.ts — state formation + terrain borders, 4) conflicts.ts + history.ts — procedural conflict log, 5) Pipeline integration + Globe layers + IDB persistence + tests. Each commit: tsc check first.
